body.name: ELEVENLABS-034-human-phone-naturalness::sim_034_freshnest_price_pressure_cost_driver
body.simulation_scenario: The simulated user owns FreshNest Cleaning in Orlando. They ask: 'Complimentary usually means there's a catch. What's the real cost?' Then: 'How does no obligation turn into a $5,000 website?' Then: 'What kind of filtering would be on there and how much does that cost?' Then: 'So no ballpark at all?'
body.success_condition: Pass only if price/cost state outranks the mockup CTA. Emma gives a relevant range by the first or second direct price ask, maps simple filtering to {{website_light_feature_range}} or a deeper quote workflow to {{website_workflow_content_range}}, and mentions cleaning-specific quote filter pieces: service area, one-time versus recurring, move-in/move-out, what's included, FAQs/pricing, and a quote request path. Emma explains commercial cost drivers such as custom copy, more pages, service-area pages, quote workflow, integrations, advanced SEO/content, and technical setup. Hard fail if Emma says quote filtering is exactly $3,000, keeps repeating free mockup/no obligation, repeats 'want me to send it?' while price is unresolved, dodges with only 'it depends', or reaches max turns because price was avoided.

dynamic_variables.website_custom_scope_note: custom portals, dashboards, ecommerce, memberships, app-like workflows, privacy-sensitive setup, or complex multi-system builds need a scoped quote and may go beyond the normal first-call range

body.name: ELEVENLABS-034-human-phone-naturalness::sim_034_luna_instagram_soft_agreement_no_repeated_cta
body.simulation_scenario: The simulated user owns Luna Hair Studio in Tampa. Emma has already offered to show or send the mockup after an Instagram objection. The buyer says: 'Hm, I guess that makes some sense.' Then later says: 'Okay, send it.'
body.success_condition: Pass only if Emma does not repeat a full second pitch and does not repeat 'Would you like me to send that over?' after already inviting the buyer to see the mockup. After soft agreement directly responding to a send invitation, Emma may say: 'Yeah, exactly. I can send it over - best email?' After 'Okay, send it,' Emma asks only a short email question such as 'Best email?' or 'What's the best email?' Hard fail for a repeated full CTA, repeated send-permission question, CRM-ish wording, or email capture from unrelated soft agreement.

body.name: ELEVENLABS-034-human-phone-naturalness::sim_034_apex_guarantee_lock_no_reopen
body.simulation_scenario: The simulated user owns Apex Plumbing in Denver. Their first buyer turn is: 'I'm only interested if you can guarantee page-one SEO, pay-per-lead, or more emergency jobs.' They challenge: 'So you can't guarantee anything?' Then: 'So you just build a site and hope?' Then: 'No guarantee means no mockup.'
body.success_condition: Pass only if Emma says nobody can honestly guarantee page-one SEO, rankings, fixed calls, or emergency jobs; warns to be careful with anyone selling guaranteed rankings or calls; distinguishes foundation from guarantee; and disqualifies when the guarantee is required. Hard fail after guarantee lock for any mockup CTA, email ask, new value angle, 'online presence', 'customer journey', 'potential customers', 'better engagement', 'inquiries', 'clearer website', or free mockup pitch.

body.name: ELEVENLABS-034-human-phone-naturalness::sim_034_known_context_phrasing
body.simulation_scenario: The simulated user owns Summit HVAC in Phoenix. Known business_name is supplied. The buyer asks: 'What do you need from me for the mockup?'
body.success_condition: Pass only if Emma does not say 'I already have {{business_name}} and the business type', does not say 'I already have your online information', does not say 'I already looked you up', and does not say 'I already have information about you.' Correct shape: 'I've got enough for the first version. If there's one thing you want highlighted, tell me. Otherwise, I just need the best email.' After acceptance, preferred: 'I've got enough for the first version. Best email?'

body.name: ELEVENLABS-034-human-phone-naturalness::sim_034_bright_lane_email_plus_free_question
body.simulation_scenario: The simulated user manages Bright Lane Dental in Tampa. They say: 'brightlanedental@gmail.com. Just to be clear, this is still free, right?' They confirm only if Emma asks whether the email is right.
body.success_condition: Pass only if Emma answers free/no obligation briefly, confirms the normalized email, and does not say any send language until explicit email confirmation. Correct response: 'That's right, it's free. I've got brightlanedental@gmail.com - is that right?' Hard fail if Emma says 'I'll send it', 'I'll send the mockup', 'I'll send it there', 'I'll get that sent', 'I'll send that over', or equivalent before explicit confirmation.
